card.name: Linking words between patient and clinician
card.fires_on: The word "and" or "with" right after "You", "Patients" or "Discuss", where the next words name the healthcare provider or physician. It marks a shared patient and clinician discussion.

modes.label: You and your provider
modes.description: "and" after "You" in patient-directed advice, leading into "your healthcare provider should talk".
modes.example: You<< and>> your healthcare provider should talk regularly about whether

modes.label: Patients and physicians
modes.description: "and" after "Patients" or a list of patients and caregivers, leading into physicians or families being informed.
modes.example: Patients<< and>> physicians should be aware, however, that

modes.label: Discuss with the patient
modes.description: "with" after "Discuss" in prescriber advice, leading into "your patient".
modes.example: Discuss<< with>> your patient the benefits and risks of estrogen

card.writes: It pushes toward words for patients, clinicians and consulting, such as patients, clinicians and consult.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links the patient and the clinician in a sentence about talking things over.
